description: This file defines a wrapper function 'selectStyled' around the imported 'select' function from '@clack/prompts'. It adds styling to the prompt message and hints by applying 'stylePromptMessage' and 'stylePromptHint', respectively.

methods.name: export function selectStyled<T>(params: Parameters<typeof select<T>>[0]) { selectStyled
methods.description: A generic function that extends the 'select' prompt by applying custom styling to the message and hint options.
